description: TikTok Shop Just Saved Kylie Jenner’s Brand, Sprinter 😰 Is it the next big name brand? 😱
transcript: Kylie Jenner's brand, sprinter, was just saved by TikTok Shop. Why? Because it launched like a traditional celebrity brand. At first, the marketing was heavily focused on celebrity visuals, launch hype, polish campaigns, and Kylie branding. But that alone doesn't work like it used to because attention has shifted from celebrities to creators. And that's where TikTok Shop completely changed the game. Here's what started happening. And instead of people seeing polished ads, brands are now using TikTok to flood the feeds with taste test, girls night content, restocks, ranking flavor videos, casual creator reviews. And now her product felt more cultural instead of corporate. That's the unlock. TikTok Shop works because creators normalize products through repetition. And brands especially benefit from this because they're highly social, visually aesthetic, easy to review, and are impulse driven. One creator video can instantly make a drink feel trendy, viral, socially approved, and worth trying. And TikTok Shop compresses this entire funnel from discovery, social proof, checkout, and purchase all inside one feed. That's why it's so powerful. And here's the bigger strategy shift. TikTok Shop is helping celebrity brands transition from celebrity owned products into creator distribution products. That's a massive difference because creator ecosystems scale way better than celebrity hype alone. But let me know what you think. Will they become the next big name brand?
